_comment: Driver and rider biographies, served from the content repo. Deliberately holds only STABLE biographical facts - current points, position and wins come live from the series APIs, so this file does not go stale mid-season. Leave a field out rather than guessing at it.

drivers.name: Andrea Kimi Antonelli
drivers.bio: The son of sportscar racer Marco Antonelli, Kimi Antonelli joined the Mercedes junior programme in 2019 at the age of twelve and climbed the single-seater ladder at remarkable speed. He was promoted straight to the Mercedes Formula 1 team for 2025 as Lewis Hamilton's replacement, one of the youngest drivers ever to take a seat at a front-running team.
highlights: FIA Karting European Champion in the OK class, 2020
Double Formula 4 champion in 2022, winning both the Italian and German titles
Formula Regional Middle East and Formula Regional European champion in 2023
Race winner in Formula 2 with Prema in 2024
First Italian winner of a Formula 1 Grand Prix since 2006, at Shanghai in March 2026

drivers.name: Lewis Hamilton
drivers.bio: One of the most successful drivers in the history of the sport, Lewis Hamilton reached Formula 1 with McLaren in 2007 and won the title in only his second season. After a long and dominant spell at Mercedes he moved to Ferrari in 2025, joining the most famous team in motorsport at the age of forty.
highlights: Won on debut weekend podiums and finished runner-up in his rookie season by a single point
Holds the record for most career pole positions
Moved from Mercedes to Ferrari for the 2025 season

image.credit: Picture by Lauren Hurley / No 10 Downing Street

drivers.name: George Russell
drivers.bio: George Russell won back-to-back junior titles before spending three seasons rebuilding his reputation in an uncompetitive Williams. Promoted to Mercedes for 2022, he took his maiden Grand Prix victory that same year and has led the team's driver line-up since Lewis Hamilton's departure.
highlights: GP3 Series champion in 2017
FIA Formula 2 champion in 2018
First Formula 1 victory at the 2022 Sao Paulo Grand Prix

drivers.name: Charles Leclerc
drivers.bio: A product of the Ferrari Driver Academy, Charles Leclerc won titles in GP3 and Formula 2 in consecutive years before a debut season with Sauber earned him a Ferrari seat for 2019. He is renowned for his single-lap pace and has been Ferrari's lead qualifier for much of his time with the team.
highlights: GP3 Series champion in 2016
FIA Formula 2 champion in 2017 at the first attempt
Won his home Grand Prix in Monaco, having grown up on those streets

drivers.name: Lando Norris
drivers.bio: Lando Norris joined McLaren in 2019 and grew up alongside the team's return to the front of the grid. After a long run of podium finishes he took his first Grand Prix win at Miami in 2024, and has since been a regular contender at the sharp end.
highlights: FIA Formula 3 European champion in 2017
Formula 2 runner-up in 2018 in his rookie season
First Formula 1 victory at the 2024 Miami Grand Prix
Formula 1 World Champion in 2025

image.credit: Original: Steffen Prößdorf; Derivative work: Mb2437

drivers.name: Max Verstappen
drivers.bio: Max Verstappen became the youngest driver ever to start a Formula 1 race when he debuted at seventeen, and the youngest ever winner when he took victory on his first outing for Red Bull in 2016. Four consecutive world titles from 2021 to 2024 established him as the dominant driver of his era.
highlights: World Champion in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024
Youngest driver ever to start a Formula 1 Grand Prix, aged 17
Won on his Red Bull debut at the 2016 Spanish Grand Prix
Holds the outright lap record at Silverstone's current configuration

drivers.name: Jorge Martin
drivers.bio: Nicknamed Martinator, Jorge Martin built a reputation as one of the fiercest qualifiers in MotoGP before taking the world title in 2024. He moved to Aprilia as reigning champion, one of the highest-profile transfers in recent Grand Prix motorcycle racing.
highlights: Moto3 World Champion in 2018
MotoGP World Champion in 2024
Moved to Aprilia Racing as the reigning champion

drivers.name: Marc Marquez
drivers.bio: One of the most decorated riders in Grand Prix motorcycle racing, Marc Marquez won the premier-class title in his rookie season and dominated the category for much of the following decade. A severe arm injury in 2020 interrupted his career, and his return to the front of the field with Ducati is one of the sport's great comeback stories.
highlights: Won the MotoGP world title in his rookie premier-class season, 2013
World champion in the 125cc and Moto2 categories before stepping up
Returned to winning ways with Ducati after a career-threatening arm injury

drivers.name: Ai Ogura
drivers.bio: Ai Ogura became the first Japanese rider to win a Grand Prix motorcycle racing world title since 2009 when he took the Moto2 crown in 2024, then stepped up to MotoGP with Trackhouse. A graduate of the Asia Talent Cup, he is the first rider from that programme to reach the premier class.
highlights: Moto2 World Champion in 2024
First Japanese world champion in Grand Prix motorcycle racing since 2009
First Asia Talent Cup graduate to reach MotoGP

drivers.name: Jake Dennis
drivers.bio: Jake Dennis came to Formula E from a background in GT and sportscar racing, and won the drivers' title in the 2022-23 season with Avalanche Andretti. He is known for his precision in Formula E's energy-management battles, where saving power at the right moment matters as much as raw speed.
highlights: Formula E World Champion in the 2022-23 season
Race winner in his rookie Formula E campaign
Came to single-seater electric racing via GT and sportscar competition
